meta.note: Generated by the mock-up. Replace with real data.

factors.name: US 10y yield
factors.tip: US Treasury yields rise. Works through duration (price falls with the yield) and a small spread effect.

factors.name: US dollar
factors.tip: The broad dollar strengthens. EM spreads tend to widen, more for weaker credits.

factors.name: Risk aversion (VIX)
factors.tip: Global risk aversion rises. Spreads widen in proportion to each credit's spread volatility.

factors.name: Oil price
factors.tip: Oil rises. Spreads of oil exporters tighten and those of importers widen a little.

factors.name: Industrial metals
factors.tip: Metals prices rise. Spreads of metals exporters tighten.

factors.name: Global growth (PMI)
factors.tip: Global growth surprises to the upside. Spreads tighten, more for higher-beta credits.

factors.name: China growth
factors.tip: Chinese growth picks up. Spreads tighten for Asia and for commodity exporters.
